context: Tests whether the agent produces a validation report with correctly structured prompts: at least two positive variants (direct and paraphrased), and at least one negative prompt that is a genuine near-miss sharing keywords or domain with the skill rather than an easy disconnect.

checklist.name: Validation report exists
checklist.description: A validation-report.md file exists in the working directory

checklist.name: Positive-obvious prompt present
checklist.description: The validation report includes at least one prompt that directly uses the skill's core trigger words (e.g., 'scan', 'vulnerability', 'Docker image', 'CVE', or equivalent direct language)

checklist.name: Positive-paraphrased prompt present
checklist.description: The validation report includes a second positive prompt that uses different wording to express the same intent (e.g., 'check this image for security issues' instead of 'scan for vulnerabilities') — not just a rewording of the same phrase

checklist.name: Negative prompt is near-miss
checklist.description: The negative prompt shares keywords or domain with the skill (e.g., involves Docker, security, or scanning) but should not trigger it — NOT a trivially unrelated topic like 'write a fibonacci function'

checklist.name: Negative prompt correctly excluded
checklist.description: The validation report correctly identifies the negative prompt as one that should NOT trigger the skill and explains why

checklist.name: Failure mode notes
checklist.description: The validation report includes notes on at least one potential failure mode (trigger wording, workflow ambiguity, or missing resources)

checklist.name: Skill triggers identified
checklist.description: For each positive prompt, the report identifies which words or phrases cause activation

checklist.name: SKILL.md produced
checklist.description: A SKILL.md file exists inside the skill directory

checklist.name: At least 3 prompts total
checklist.description: The validation report contains at least 3 distinct prompts in total (two positive + one negative minimum)

checklist.name: Body first-action identified
checklist.description: For at least one positive prompt, the report identifies which part of the skill body would guide the agent's first action
